daily.today_energy: With the Moon in your sign, you're running on pure emotional intuition right now. That said, today's Sun-Mars-Jupiter square is creating some friction between what you want and what actually feels sustainable. Trust your gut, but maybe sleep on big decisions.
daily.love: Venus is playing nice with Jupiter, so there's genuine warmth in your connections today. If you're single, you might feel more open to possibilities. If you're coupled up, vulnerability goes a long way. Just don't let the Mars energy push you into saying something you'll regret.
daily.career: Mars-Jupiter conjunction is amplifying ambition across the board, but that Sun square is a reality check. You've got the drive to make moves, but pace yourself. This is a good day to plan rather than launch—your follow-through will be sharper tomorrow.
daily.health: The Moon in Pisces is asking you to actually rest today. With all this planetary tension, your nervous system needs it. Gentle movement, hydration, and genuine downtime aren't lazy—they're necessary recalibration.

weekly.overview: Mercury's vibes are shifting your communication game this week, Pisces. You're feeling more grounded than usual, ready to turn daydreams into actual plans. Trust the subtle nudges pointing you toward meaningful conversations and authentic connections.
weekly.love: Your emotional radar is incredibly sharp right now. Whether you're coupled up or exploring connections, honesty flows easier than it has in weeks. Someone might surprise you with vulnerability—meet them there. Singles: that text you've been debating? Send it.
weekly.career: This is your moment to speak up in spaces where you've stayed quiet. Your ideas have serious merit, and the cosmic timing supports bringing them forward. Collaborations feel especially fruitful. Energy tip: groundedness over perfectionism right now.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness this week. This is the perfect time to explore what truly nourishes you—whether that's movement, rest, or time near water. Listen to what your nervous system needs without judgment. Tune in and act accordingly.
